div.span: This section will provide phenomenological grounding (ie. what we really mean when we say anything) for the relevant terms used in this project - serving as a form of accountability for how this project uses those terms, as well as allowing easy deconstruction of objections to any of the project's results. This is currently being developed in a different project, by which only a summary of it will be mentioned here.
